# graylog_extractors (Data Source)

Lists extractors for a specific Graylog input.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graylog_extractors" "example" {
  input_id = "input-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `input_id` (String)

### Read-Only
